summary: The diff implements REQ-20 comprehensively. A new Footer component is created with the official email as a mailto: link, integrated site-wide via App.tsx. The Homepage gains a 'Get in Touch' contact section with the mailto: link. StudentDashboard, TeacherDashboard, and AdminDashboard each have support banners with the mailto: link. All usages correctly point to 'pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com'. No files in frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui were modified.
